description: October 11 birthday meaning: Libra decan 2, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 11 birthday falls in Libra, in the second decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Uranus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: October 11 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Master number 11, kept unreduced, gives October 11 an intuitive, slightly electric quality. Seventeen degrees of Libra places the Sun in the Uranus decan, so flashes of insight are a recurring motif. Numerology and astrology agree on sensitivity here; the traditional advice is to give that sensitivity a creative outlet, whether design, music or advocacy, so it does not turn into nervousness.

On October 11 the Sun usually sits at about 17° Libra, in the second decan, where Uranus is the sub-ruler alongside Venus. The middle stretch of Libra, roughly October 3 to October 13, takes Uranus as sub-ruler, the planet associated with Aquarius in modern astrology. This tends to turn the sign's interest in fairness towards society at large. Natives are often pictured as idealistic, progressive and drawn to groups, networks and causes. Their relationships may be unconventional, or built on friendship and shared values more than tradition. Uranus brings originality and also a cool, detached streak when emotions run high. Combining their sense of justice with personal warmth usually helps them persuade rather than simply be right.

sections.heading: October 11 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 11th, you have a birthday number of 11, and because it is a master number it stays unreduced. The day of birth is a secondary number in numerology, yet master numbers are traditionally given extra weight wherever they appear. Two 1s side by side suggest doubled sensitivity as well as doubled initiative: the 11 is linked with intuition, inspiration and a nervous, creative charge. Those born on this date are often described as idealistic and perceptive, sometimes picking up on things before they can explain why. Grounding routines and trusted company tend to help them carry that intensity comfortably.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one October 11 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on October 11: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 11 is the 284th day of the year (285th in a leap year). By October 24, 13 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Scorpio.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by October 11, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on October 11 include Eleanor Roosevelt (1884), Amitabh Bachchan (1942) and François Mauriac (1885).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 11?
faq.answer: October 11 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Libra, which tradition links with Uranus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 11?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 11 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 11th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 11?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an October 11 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 11?
faq.answer: October 11 is also the birthday of Eleanor Roosevelt (1884), Amitabh Bachchan (1942) and François Mauriac (1885). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
